title: AccessToken
description: The OAuth 2.0 client-credentials token response from POST /oauth/token.

access_token.description: Bearer token to send as 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}'.

expires_in.description: Token lifetime in seconds. RevContent issues 86400 (24 hours).

scope.description: Space-delimited roles granted to this credential pair. Observed value: 'advertiser publisher'. Not requestable.
